keys.raw: bare strings from store.rawSet; null = unset

excluded: photo library and personal background images, garage (parts, liveries, setup sheets, MY TEAM), saves (career, season, leaderboards, ghosts, daily challenge), accounts and network (Spotify, TURN, relays), renderer self-heal latches, developer flags

where.display.hudScale: js/ui/scale.js + css/tokens.css (null = 100%; touch defaults 100 hud / 109 ui, scale.js scaleDefault)
where.display.hudPanelOpacity: js/ui/scale.js PANEL OPACITY (null = 100%; HIGH CONTRAST keeps plates solid)
where.appearance.titleLayout: js/ui/title-layout.js TITLE LAYOUT (null = shipped; else {v:2, wide, tall}, one {btns,title,art,layout,side} per shape — a missing shape is shipped; a v1 object is both)
where.appearance.lookPause: js/ui/screen-looks.js PAUSE MENU buttons & card (null = shipped; else {knob: value} for the knobs off their defaults — ScreenLooks.normalize validates)
where.appearance.lookSelect: js/ui/screen-looks.js TRACK SELECTOR (null = shipped; else {knob: value} for the knobs off their defaults — ScreenLooks.normalize validates)
where.appearance.lookRace: js/ui/screen-looks.js RACE SETTINGS (null = shipped; else {knob: value} for the knobs off their defaults — ScreenLooks.normalize validates)
where.appearance.lookCareer: js/ui/screen-looks.js CAREER (null = shipped; else {knob: value} for the knobs off their defaults — ScreenLooks.normalize validates)
where.appearance.lookGarage: js/ui/screen-looks.js GARAGE (null = shipped; else {knob: value} for the knobs off their defaults — ScreenLooks.normalize validates)
where.display.buildWorker: js/track/build-client.js BUILD IN BACKGROUND (unset = ON when multi-core; "0"/"1" force)
where.display.gfxBackend: js/perf/renderer-picker.js + js/game.js boot (unset = TLX/Three on every device)
where.camera.flybyShots: js/camera/flyby-panel.js FLYBY SHOT EDITOR (null = shipped shots)
where.camera.ldCard: js/ui/loading-screen.js loading card {scale, x, y} (null = shipped)
where.driving.raceDraft: js/race/race-settings.js REMEMBER LAST RACE SETUP (null = 3 laps / dry / default; else {laps: "3"|"5"|"10"|"25"|"FULL", weather, tod, mixed})
where.driving.favTracks: js/ui/select-screen.js FAVOURITE CIRCUITS (null = none; else an array of track ids)
